news.title: Pine Labs Limited (NSEI:PINELABS) agreed to acquire Shopflo Technologies Private Limited for INR 880 million.
news.body:
Pine Labs Limited (NSEI:PINELABS) agreed to acquire Shopflo Technologies Private Limited for INR 880 million on April 25, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 880 million will be paid by Pine Labs Limited. The Transaction is approved by Pine Labs Limited (NSEI:PINELABS) Board.

The transaction is expected to close within three months from agreement date.

news.title: Pine Labs Appoints Shalini Pillai as Chief Marketing Officer
news.body: Pine Labs, announced the appointment of industry veteran Shalini Pillai as its new Chief Marketing Officer (CMO). In this role, Shalini will lead global marketing strategy, product marketing, marcom, and brand positioning for Pine Labs. Prior to joining Pine Labs, Shalini was the Marketing Director - India and South Asia at Microsoft. A decade-plus veteran of Google and Microsoft and a former entrepreneur, she has a proven track record of scaling high-impact portfolios across consumer apps, digital payments, and enterprise ecosystems. Her nearly two decades of experience and expertise in bridging deep-tech innovation with aggressive market acquisition will be pivotal as she spearheads Pine Labs' marketing and growth strategy across its global footprint. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.38 (vs ₹0.57 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.38 (up from ₹0.57 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹7.44b (up 24% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹423.9m (up ₹990.6m from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 5.7% (up from net loss in 3Q 2025). The move to profitability was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 20% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 14% growth forecast for the Diversified Financial industry in India.

news.title: High number of new and inexperienced directors
news.body: There are 5 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: 5 new directors. 1 experienced director. No highly experienced directors. President, CBO of Digital Infrastructure & Transaction platform and Whole-Time Director Kush Mehra is the most experienced director on the board, commencing their role in 2018. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Lack of board continuity. Lack of experienced directors.
